actions.mechanism: A required passage reference binds each definition to the supplied material and blocks dangling citations.
actions.implementation: Import supplied passages with immutable IDs. Require every definition variant to reference an existing passage ID; reject unknown IDs and external-source references.
actions.check: Attempt saves with missing, unknown, and valid passage IDs. Only the valid reference succeeds; deleting its passage is blocked.
actions.risk: A valid reference does not establish that wording is supported.

actions.action: Keep competing definitions as separate variants.
actions.mechanism: Variant records preserve disagreement without forcing an editor to overwrite or merge competing wording.
actions.implementation: Store each wording under the same term with its own ID and required passage ID. Record disputes between variants, including reasons; retain superseded wording.
actions.check: Enter two conflicting definitions, then revise one. Both original wordings, their passage links, and the dispute remain inspectable.
actions.risk: Numerous variants can obscure the disagreement without clear labels.

actions.action: Show definitions, passages, and disputes together.
actions.mechanism: An expandable comparison view lets readers inspect competing wording against its cited passages without losing context.
actions.implementation: Add a source-and-disagreement control to each definition. Display the full referenced passage, passage ID, competing variants, and recorded dispute reasons; support keyboard navigation.
actions.check: Starting from either disputed variant, verify a reader can open its source and reach every linked competing wording using only the keyboard.
actions.risk: Long passages may require scrolling; excerpts alone can conceal context.

actions.action: Review wording changes against their cited passages.
actions.mechanism: A review queue separates citation existence from editorial judgments about whether the passage supports the definition.
actions.implementation: Queue new and revised variants for passage-only review. Record supported, disputed, or pending status with reasons; retain wording and passage IDs regardless of judgment.
actions.check: Revise a reviewed definition. Confirm its new revision becomes pending while the previous wording and review remain available.
actions.risk: Review labels reflect editorial judgments, not independent verification.
